text:
Mark tells you that there are two
groups of children and teens in
town. They used fight each other.
They call themselves the Witch
children and the Halloween gang.
The members of the Halloween
Gang were older. The Witch
children were a group of bullied
children assembled and led by a
girl called Eliza Dunforth. Eliza got
Mirina, a talking doll, as a present
from Marjorie McAllister, a very
old lady from out of town.
Everybody said that this old lady
was a witch. Following instructions
from Mirina, Eliza found a book of
magic spells in a forest. She then
used these spells to punish the
Halloween Gang. But something
went wrong. The magic she used
was too powerful for her to
handle. Strange, dangerous doors
started to open into other places.
The Halloween Gang got in contact
with some creatures who came
out of these doors, and started to
do what they asked.
If you want, you could go in the
forest and check the place where,
according to Mark’s story, Eliza
found her spell book. If you want
to do so, go to #41. If you do not
want to do so, continue with your
exploration of the town.

zh-CN.title: 37. 马克讲述故事
text:
马克告诉你，镇上有两群孩子和青少年，他们过去经常打架，分别叫女巫孩子帮和万圣节帮派。万圣节帮派成员年纪更大。女巫孩子帮则是一群遭受霸凌的孩子，由一个叫伊莱莎·邓福斯的女孩组织并领导。镇外一位年迈老妇人玛乔丽·麦卡利斯特把会说话的娃娃米莉娜送给伊莱莎作礼物。大家都说那老妇人是女巫。按照米莉娜的指示，伊莱莎在森林里找到一本魔法咒语书，随后用书上的咒语惩罚万圣节帮派。然而事情出了岔子，她使用的魔法太过强大，自己无法控制。通往异界的奇异危险之门开始打开。万圣节帮派与从门中出来的生物接触，并开始听从它们的要求。
如果你愿意，可以前往森林，调查马克所说伊莱莎找到咒语书的地方。要去的话，前往#41；否则继续探索小镇。
